## Edge cases

- `session-env.sh` has `LARCH_RUN_ID`, but `session-id` is absent.
- NDJSON body has plain bullets such as `- a`.
- NDJSON body has bold-label bullets such as `- **step5**: a`.
- NDJSON matching row has no bullets.
- Execution issue sections appear in any order.
- `review_status:` or `rounds_completed:` appears in normal plan content.
- `/design` provenance appears before `diff_lines:`.
- Cursor CI fix role needs `stall_channel="stdout"`.
- Explicit `launch_codex_exec_main --workdir` must never be overridden.

## Failure modes

- Global provenance stripping can delete valid plan content.
- Narrow trailer detection can leave machine metadata in `plan.txt`.
- Bold-only counting misses plain Markdown bullets.
- Per-record NDJSON counting undercounts multi-bullet rows.
- EOF insertion can put entries under the wrong execution-issue section.
- Equality-based `--workdir` omission detection can override explicit same-cwd values.
- Validating the raw argparse default before resolution can launch from the plugin cache.
- Cursor CI stall changes can break fix-role stdout monitoring.

## Testing strategy

Run focused tests:

```bash
python3 -m pytest python/test_step_7a.py python/test_pr_body.py python/test_execution_issues.py python/test_bootstrap.py python/test_agents.py -x
```

Run the audit reference structure test:

---PLAN END?---
     292 <TMPDIR>/plan.txt

```bash
make test-plan-adequacy-audit
```

Run full validation:

```bash
make py-lint
make py-test
make lint
```

## Acceptance

- `run_step7a` uses `LARCH_RUN_ID=run-99` when `session-id` is absent.
- All issue-count paths count top-level `^- ` bullets.
- Structured NDJSON rows count per bullet, with `max(1, count)` per matching row.
- Execution issue append inserts inside the target section.
- `IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plan.txt` strips only terminal provenance metadata.
- `preflight/plan-from-issue.txt` remains unchanged.
- The plan audit ignores only terminal `/design` provenance near `diff_lines:`.
- Codex CI and Cursor CI launch from the resolved consumer repo.
- Cursor CI fix role keeps `stdout` stall monitoring.
- Default Codex exec resolves the consumer repo before validation.
- Explicit Codex exec `--workdir` is honored unchanged.
- Focused tests, `make test-plan-adequacy-audit`, `make py-lint`, `make py-test`, and `make lint` pass.

     3	This document is the **LIVE** normative wire format for exchanging a plan

     6	`python/cli.py plan-block ...`, `python/cli.py named-block write`, `python/clarify.py`, and the
     7	`python/cli.py clarify` state, comment-post, and label verbs are what
     8	`/design` and `/implement` use:
     9	`/implement` **Preflight** (`skills/implement/SKILL.md` — issue-anchored
    10	plan) on non-emergency runs reads the plan block, runs the in-prompt
    11	plan-adequacy audit, and on
    12	refuse posts a clarify request and label via
    13	`python/cli.py clarify comment-post` / `python/cli.py clarify label`
    14	(exit **3**).
    15	`/implement --emergency` skips the in-prompt plan-adequacy audit and may

    18	writes the plan block via `python/cli.py named-block write --marker plan` and posts matching clarify

    20	
    21	## Disambiguation: issue-body `larch:plan:*` vs tracking-issue `<!-- larch:plan v1 … -->`
    22	
    23	Do **not** confuse this document's paired **issue-body** HTML comment
    24	delimiters (`<!-- larch:plan:start -->` … `<!-- larch:plan:end -->`) with the
    25	**shipped** slim tracking-issue comment marker `<!-- larch:plan v1 runid=<R> -->`
    26	used when `/implement` publishes plan-related digests on a run's tracking
    27	issue. The former embeds a full plan in the **issue description body**; the
    28	latter is a single-line marker prefix inside a **GitHub comment** on the
    29	tracking issue. See `docs/run-logs.md` (tracking-issue comment contracts) and
    30	`skills/implement/references/summary-comment-template.md`. The name family
    31	overlaps (`larch:plan`); the **surface and syntax differ**.
    32	
    33	### Which issue carries the plan body vs clarification vs tracking summaries
    34	
    35	- **Plan body** (`<!-- larch:plan:start -->` … `<!-- larch:plan:end -->`): lives
    36	  on the **plan anchor issue** — the GitHub issue whose description is the
    37	  canonical home for the embedded plan (often the feature or design issue for
    38	  the work item).
    39	- **Clarification markers** (`larch:clarify-request` / `larch:clarify-response`):
    40	  MUST appear in **issue comments on the same plan anchor issue** as the body
    41	  markers they pair with. Automation pairs requests and responses by `id`
    42	  within that issue’s comment stream; it MUST NOT infer pairing from a
    43	  different issue’s thread.
    44	- **Tracking-issue summaries** (`<!-- larch:plan v1 runid=<R> -->` and related
    45	  digest comments): live on the **tracking issue** for the `/implement` run
    46	  (see `docs/run-logs.md`). They are **not** interchangeable with the plan
    47	  anchor’s body markers or clarification comments.
    48	
    49	When operators keep human plan prose on an issue **other than** the tracking
    50	issue, tooling MUST still treat only the issue that contains the
    51	`larch:plan:start` / `larch:plan:end` pair as the clarification and plan-update
    52	anchor. Tracking-issue digest markers do not relocate or substitute for that
    53	pairing surface unless an explicit, documented bridge (out of scope here)
    54	copies or links the threads.

    56	## Plan Block Format
    57	
    58	A plan block is embedded in an issue body between two HTML comment markers:
    59	
    60	```
    61	<!-- larch:plan:start -->
    62	## Plan
    63	
    64	... free-form markdown ...
    65	
    66	## Acceptance
    67	- ...
    68	<!-- larch:plan:end -->

    71	Rules:
    72	
    73	- Exactly one `larch:plan:start` / `larch:plan:end` pair per issue body.
    74	- Free-form markdown is permitted between the markers.
    75	- New `/design` plan writes include plan-review provenance lines:

    77	  before the final size-trailer block so `diff_lines: <N>` remains the final
    78	  non-empty line.
